observations.why: The directive 'Forget' performs a self-originated command to discard prior knowledge, appealing to the speaker's own authority over what is retained.
The imperative to 'Remove all knowledge' enacts self-origination — the speaker dictates what the record should and should not hold.
The declarative asserts a stable historical fact to preserve a corrected record against a prior claim, appealing to keeping what is true and settled.
